how: Questions are refreshed monthly from recent sources (new competition problems, recent papers and datasets) so models cannot have memorized them; answers are scored automatically without an LLM judge.
name: LiveBench
note: Useful cross-check against benchmarks a model may have trained on; the public leaderboard updates as new models and question sets land.
measures: Contamination-resistant general capability: math, coding, reasoning, language, instruction following, and data analysis, scored against objective ground truth.
maintainer: Abacus.AI, NYU, and collaborators (White et al.)
not_measured: Human preference, safety, tool use, or multimodal ability; question styles still favor short verifiable answers.
